rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for a ruling family line and is also used metaphorically for a sports team’s long period of dominance.

example.english: This dynasty lasted for several hundred years.
example.traditional: 呢個王朝延續咗幾百年。
example.jyutping: ni1 go3 wong4 ciu4 jin4 zuk6 zo2 gei2 baak3 nin4

rows.note: Use this specifically when referring to a historical dynasty as an era or period of rule rather than mainly to the ruling family.

example.english: The culture of this dynasty had a profound influence on later generations.
example.traditional: 呢個朝代嘅文化對後世影響好深。
example.jyutping: ni1 go3 ziu1 doi6 ge3 man4 faa3 deoi3 hau6 sai3 jing2 hoeng2 hou2 sam1
